## Course Overview

This course covers the fundamentals and advanced topics in deep learning, from the mathematical foundations through modern generative AI architectures. Students will gain both theoretical understanding and practical implementation skills using PyTorch.

**Topics include:**

- Mathematics for Deep Learning (Calculus, Linear Algebra, Probability)
- Multi-Layer Perceptrons, Backpropagation, Universal Approximation Theorem
- Optimization (SGD, Momentum, AdaGrad, Adam, RMSProp)
- Regularisation (L1/L2, Dropout, DropBlock, Batch Normalization, Data Augmentation)
- Convolutional Neural Networks (LeNet-5, VGG-16, AlexNet, GoogLeNet, InceptionNet, ResNet)
- Recurrent Neural Networks, LSTMs, and variants
- Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs)
- Variational Autoencoders (VAEs)
- Diffusion Models
- Attention Mechanism and Transformers
- Normalising Flows
- Graph Neural Networks
- Transfer Learning, Domain Adaptation, Self-Supervised Learning
- Neural Tangent Kernel, Uncertainty Quantification


## Recommended Background

While there are no formal prerequisites, the following background will be very helpful:

- **Python Programming** — comfortable with NumPy, matplotlib, and basic OOP
- **Linear Algebra** — vectors, matrices, eigenvalues, SVD
- **Calculus** — partial derivatives, chain rule, gradients
- **Probability & Statistics** — distributions, Bayes' rule, expectations


## Textbooks

**Primary References:**

1. **Deep Learning: Foundations and Concepts** — Bishop & Bishop, Springer 2024
2. **Understanding Deep Learning** — Simon J.D. Prince, MIT Press 2023 — [Free Online](https://udlbook.github.io/udlbook/)
3. **Deep Learning: A Visual Approach** — Andrew Glassner, No Starch Press 2021
4. **The Principles of Deep Learning Theory** — Roberts, Yaida & Hanin, Cambridge 2022 — [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.10165v1)
5. **Deep Learning** — Goodfellow, Bengio & Courville, MIT Press 2016 — [Free Online](https://www.deeplearningbook.org/)
6. **Dive into Deep Learning** — Zhang, Lipton, Li & Smola, 2020 — [Free Online](https://d2l.ai/)
7. **Alice's Adventures in a Differentiable Wonderland** — Simone Scardapane, 2024
8. **Neural Networks and Deep Learning** — Michael Nielsen, 2015 — [Free Online](http://neuralnetworksanddeeplearning.com/)


**Additional References:**

- **A Brief Introduction to Neural Networks** — David Kriesel — [Free Online](http://www.dkriesel.com/en/science/neural_networks)
- **Patterns, Predictions, and Actions** — Hardt & Recht, 2021 — [Free Online](https://mlstory.org/)
- **Graph Representation Learning** — William L. Hamilton, 2020
- **Deep Learning with PyTorch** — Stevens, Antiga & Viehmann, Manning 2020 — [Free PDF](https://pytorch.org/assets/deep-learning/Deep-Learning-with-PyTorch.pdf)
- **Theory of Deep Learning** — Raman Arora et al., Draft 2021


## Learning Outcomes

At the end of the course, students will be able to:

- Understand the mathematical foundations and principles of deep learning
- Design and implement deep neural network architectures (MLP, CNN, RNN, Transformers, GANs, VAEs, Diffusion Models)
- Apply optimization and regularisation techniques effectively
- Use modern deep learning frameworks (PyTorch) for practical problem solving
- Apply deep learning to research problems in sustainability, computer vision, NLP, signal processing, bioinformatics, climate modeling, and other domains
